title: Does Renewable Energy Renew Energy Efficiency?
authors: Amrou Awaysheh; Christopher J. Chen; Owen Q. Wu
eligible_reason: No binary staggered DiD. The treatment is continuous (renewable energy share G_Eng_Pct of a site's energy demand and its components); every column adds region-by-year and product-category-by-year linear trends, time-varying controls (production, fossil and renewable energy costs) and manager FE; Tables 2 and 4 also use IV (country clean-energy share, IEA/GPT policy counts). The binary OnSite indicator appears only interacted with the continuous share or as an instrumented endogenous regressor.
design_notes: Package README PDF section 2 lists felm specifications: log(1+PTOP) ~ G_Eng_Pct + Year:Cluster + Year:Lead Category | Site ID + Mgr + Month + Year | IV | Site ID. Table 2 baseline + IV; Table 3 decomposition by procurement type; Table 4 G_Eng_Pct*OnSite interaction, CEM-weighted, and IV with policy counts; Table 5 LowCost interactions. 183 sites of a multinational conglomerate, monthly 2015-2020.
data_files_note: Only a README PDF (data dictionary, R code snippets, public IV sources) and an R log (Replication_Log.Rout loads final_dat.RData, not shipped). Site-level energy data are proprietary to the conglomerate.
screener_notes: Published PDF available (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2023.02165.txt); regression inventory empty because the code is embedded in the README PDF and the log.
